items.title: Hamas says Israel tried to kill chief’s son in Gaza

items.teaser: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya's last surviving son Izzeldeen survived an Israeli assassination attempt on Friday.

items.title: Thanksgiving storm on U.S. East Coast knocks out power, disrupts flights
items.teaser: A powerful storm disrupted the Thanksgiving holiday along much of the U.S. East Coast on Thursday, knocking out power to nearly one million customers at one point as wind gusts of up to 112 km/h toppled trees and power lines.

items.teaser: Conditions continued to improve on Friday after heavy rain and strong winds lashed the coast from Virginia to New York. But many remained without power and travel disruptions persisted.

items.title: Costa Rica verweigert Francesca Albanese die Einreise
items.teaser: Terrorverdacht oder politische Abrechnung? Costa Rica verbietet einer israelkritischen Uno-Sonderberichterstatterin die Einreise und verweist auf »Verbindungen zu terroristischen Handlungen«. Es laufen mehrere Beschwerden.

items.title: UN Gaza rapporteur Francesca Albanese denied entry into Costa Rica
items.teaser: Costa Rica has barred UN special rapporteur Francesca Albanese, citing unfounded ‘links to terrorist acts’.

items.title: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and deputy secretary of state, has died
items.teaser: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as deputy secretary of state under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday. He was 80.

items.title: Strobe Talbott, Journalist Who Joined Clinton’s State Department, Has Died
items.teaser: He was a reporter and foreign affairs columnist at Time and then served as deputy secretary of state and president of the Brookings Institution. He was 80.

items.title: Sudan's lost generation: War is stealing a generation of childhood
items.teaser: Three years of war have stolen childhood from millions of children in Sudan, leaving them displaced, hungry and fighting for survival instead of learning in a classroom.

items.teaser: Ms. Stewart-Cousins, 76, served in the State Senate for 20 years.

items.title: California Hiker Falls 500 Feet to His Death While Trying to Help Son
items.teaser: Guillermo Batres, 44, slipped while hiking Mount Baden-Powell, northeast of Los Angeles, earlier this week. Two other hikers who were nearby rescued his teenage son and called 911.

items.title: Streit um Rentenreform: Arbeitsminister Schweitzer optimistisch
